labyrinthe.name: Le Labyrinthe de buis
labyrinthe.alt: A box-hedge maze in the park on a sunny afternoon, painted in ink and gouache, its winding path climbing to a stone gazebo. Sue floats above the maze on a bunch of balloons; a lion roars on a far hill on one side and a sheep stands on a far hill on the other. A shopkeeper in a little wooden kiosk holds his head over an almost empty cash drawer, and a bear hugs a chocolate cake at a stall. A little red tour train puffs round a topiary ball, children in party hats throw confetti everywhere, and a praying mantis sits nose to nose with a sleeping kitten on a stone bench. A little tour guide in a blue coat sings with his umbrella raised, and a pirate digs up a treasure chest on the path. The open iron gate on the left leads back to the park; a green door in the hedge on the right and a blue door in an ivy-covered tower lead further in.

doors.label: Le cœur du labyrinthe
doors.hint: Go through the green door in the hedge

doors.label: La tour du jardinier
doors.hint: Go through the blue door of the ivy tower

coeur.name: Le cœur du labyrinthe
coeur.alt: The secret heart of the hedge maze, painted in ink and gouache: on a little open-air stage with green curtains Tom waits while two stagehands spin a cardboard tree on wheels. A squirrel sits on a hedge top above hidden acorns, and two badgers lean over a hedge sharing a biscuit. Two cats meet nose to nose on the path, and twin hedgehogs hold identical pink ice-creams. A rabbit hops along with parsley in its mouth, a girl in a round hedge costume peeks out, and a line of snails slides through a low hedge tunnel. The green door in the hedge on the left leads back into the maze.

doors.label: Le Labyrinthe de buis
doors.hint: Go back through the green door to the maze

tour.name: La tour du jardinier
tour.alt: Inside the gardener's round stone tower, painted in ink and gouache: through the arched window a delivery van has parked right in front of the tower and the gardener's boy runs out to meet it. A mole on a stool points his stick at a red cross on a green maze map pinned to the wall. A bear cub snuggles inside a round straw den, a pigeon postman stands by a letter with a photo paper-clipped to it on the table, and a carpenter boy points at his saw on this side of a little picket fence. A spiral staircase and flower pots fill the right; the blue door on the left leads back into the maze.

doors.label: Le Labyrinthe de buis
doors.hint: Go back through the blue door to the maze
